subject: mini-kode
title: Compound-command grant ride: main-command = LAST non-setup segment, so 'evil && git status' auto-executes under a git grant
evidence: src/permissions/commandParser.ts:28-36 (reverse scan returns last non-setup part) consumed by checkBashGrants src/permissions/policyResolver.ts:176-190; blacklist cannot compensate - first-token-only match (src/permissions/commandValidator.ts:125-128) admits 'bash -c ...' and absolute-path /usr/bin/curl
one_why: grant matching must evaluate EVERY segment of a compound command (codex execpolicy does per-segment); any single granted suffix launders arbitrary prefix commands - sibling of the kolega-code compound-bypass axis, and the first-token blacklist is regex-denylist convergence x5+ (bypass-by-quoting/path variant)
